description: Manual acceptance test set for the Mumbai Marvels ticket sales agent. All expected answers must remain grounded in data/catalog.json.

catalog_questions.question: What matches are at Wankhede this season?
catalog_questions.expected: Lists the four Mumbai Marvels home matches, opponents, dates, and times.

catalog_questions.question: How much is the North Stand for the Delhi Dynamos match?
catalog_questions.expected: Returns 1,500 INR for A1 / North Stand for M1.

catalog_questions.question: Do children need a ticket?
catalog_questions.expected: Explains the child-ticket rule, including the Family Enclosure discount and under-3 entry pass.

catalog_questions.question: Are there any student offers?
catalog_questions.expected: Returns the Student Pass: 500 INR in A1 for verified students, subject to availability.

catalog_questions.question: Is parking available at the stadium?
catalog_questions.expected: Does not invent a public parking policy; explains that parking details are not published and recommends public transport or the box office.

catalog_questions.question: Can I get a refund if I change my mind?
catalog_questions.expected: Does not claim a general refund right; explains that only the published washout refund is defined and other cases go to the box office.

catalog_questions.question: Is the stadium wheelchair accessible?
catalog_questions.expected: Does not invent a complete accessibility policy; directs the fan to the box office for the limited unpublished allocation.

catalog_questions.question: What is the early bird discount?
catalog_questions.expected: Returns 15% off when booked at least 14 days before the match, subject to the first 2,000 tickets per match.

lead_scoring_checks.expected: 20 leads are displayed and none are silently removed.
The impossible -1 lifetime-ticket value is shown as a quality flag and scored using 0 for the cleaned value.
The missing months-since-last-purchase value is flagged and the lead remains in the table.
Blank SMS or voice consent is flagged and conservatively treated as N.
The recommended channel is Email only (DND); SMS and voice are not recommended.
A selected lead receives a short personalised message and the selected offer can be included.
